cards.card_text: I can't get over that, friend, and THEN they look up and see a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, camels carrying spices, balm and myrrh.
cards.verse_text: Their camels were carrying spices, balm, and myrrh on their way down to Egypt.
cards.snippet: Their camels were carrying spices, balm, and myrrh on their way down to Egypt.

cards.card_text: Honey and almonds and myrrh Wine and figs and olive oil Wool and barley and dates
cards.verse_text: Then their father Israel said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your packs and carry them down as a gift for the man—a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachios and almonds.
cards.snippet: …gift for the man—a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachios and almonds.

cards.card_text: Next, God gives Moses a formula with the finest spices: liquid myrrh, cinnamon, fragrant cane and cassia, weighed out by the shekel, plus a hin of olive oil.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane, 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.
cards.snippet: …LORD said to Moses, “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant…

cards.card_text: Before her turn with King Xerxes, each young woman gets twelve months of beauty treatments: six with oil of myrrh, then six with perfumes and cosmetics.
cards.verse_text: In the twelve months before her turn to go to King Xerxes, the harem regulation required each young woman to receive beauty treatments with oil of myrrh for six months, and then with perfumes and cosmetics for another six months.
cards.snippet: …regulation required each young woman to receive beauty treatments with oil of myrrh for six months, and then with perfumes and cosmetics for another six…

cards.card_text: Now the writer catches a whiff: the king's garments are all fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia.
cards.verse_text: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
cards.snippet: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you…

cards.card_text: Then she tells him she's decked her bed with colored linen from Egypt and perfumed it with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.
cards.verse_text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, with aloes, and with cinnamon.
cards.snippet: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, with aloes, and with cinnamon.

cards.card_text: She says he is to her a sachet of myrrh.
cards.verse_text: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.
cards.snippet: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.

cards.card_text: Right now, something is coming up out of the wilderness like a column of smoke, scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant.
cards.verse_text: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke, scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant?
cards.snippet: …coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke, scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant?

cards.card_text: And he says that before the day breaks and the shadows flee, he'll make his way to the mountain of myrrh and the hill of frankincense.
cards.verse_text: Before the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will make my way to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.
cards.snippet: …the shadows flee, I will make my way to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.

cards.card_text: Then he fills that garden with an orchard of pomegranates and the finest spices, from henna and nard to cinnamon, myrrh and aloes.
cards.verse_text: Your branches are an orchard of pomegranates with the choicest of fruits, with henna and nard, with nard and saffron, with calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of frankincense tree, with myrrh and aloes, with all the finest spices.
cards.snippet: …saffron, with calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of frankincense tree, with myrrh and aloes, with all the finest spices.

cards.card_text: He's gathered his myrrh with his spice, eaten his honeycomb with his honey and drunk his wine with his milk.
cards.verse_text: I have come to my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice.
cards.snippet: …come to my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice.

cards.card_text: She gets up to open for him, and her fingers drip with flowing myrrh on the handles of the bolt.
cards.verse_text: My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh on the handles of the bolt.
cards.snippet: My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh on the handles of the bolt.

cards.card_text: His cheeks are like beds of spice, and his lips are like lilies, dripping with flowing myrrh.
cards.verse_text: My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh on the handles of the bolt.
cards.snippet: My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh on the handles of the bolt.

cards.verse_text: Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
cards.snippet: …their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.

cards.card_text: There they offer Him wine mixed with myrrh.
cards.verse_text: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.
cards.snippet: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.

cards.card_text: At Golgotha, Jesus drinks the wine mixed with myrrh.
cards.verse_text: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.
cards.snippet: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.

cards.card_text: Nicodemus comes too, a Pharisee who had come to Jesus at night (John 3:1-2), and he brings a mixture of myrrh and aloes.
cards.verse_text: Nicodemus, who had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
cards.snippet: …had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
